versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g Optional callback after synchronous snapshot record processing If DemEventReportingType is set to IMMEDIATE_FAIL_- AND_SYNCHRONOUS_PROCESSING , the Dem shall call the configured callback Dem_- CallbackEventSyncStorageProcessed when the Dem has processed the Dem_- SetEventFailedWithSyncFreezeFrame call and is ready to receive the next call of Dem_SetEventFailedWithSyncFreezeFrame for that event.
